geometry.description: GeoJSON (RFC 7946, WGS84, [lon, lat]) Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon, or a Feature wrapping one. Rings must be closed; altitude is ignored; a FeatureCollection is refused (send one place per call); geometries crossing the antimeridian are refused; at most 500 vertices and 250 km2. Any other member (bbox, Feature properties, id) passes through unread. Invalid input is reported as invalid_input with a JSON pointer and a stable code: missing_type, unsupported_type, feature_collection, missing_coordinates, not_a_position, latitude (with a swapped-order hint), longitude, ring_too_short, ring_not_closed, too_many_vertices, too_large, antimeridian, outside_coverage.

include_boundaries.description: Also look up the intersecting county, community and tribal area polygons (three FeatureServer queries). Default true.

layers.description: Image service layers to read. Default: burn_probability, risk_to_potential_structures, conditional_risk_to_potential_structures, wildfire_hazard_potential, exposure_type.

value.data_version: Wildfire Risk to Communities version 2 (2024 update; LANDFIRE 2020 fuels, burn probability as of end of 2020)

layers.name: Risk to Homes (risk to potential structures)
Wildfire Consequence (conditional risk to potential structures)
Exposure Type
layers.unit: fraction of indirect exposure (0 not exposed, 1 directly exposed)

sources.name: Headwaters Economics WRC counties boundaries (ArcGIS FeatureServer)
Headwaters Economics WRC communities boundaries (ArcGIS FeatureServer)

200.description:
Wildfire risk for a GeoJSON geometry (Point, Polygon, MultiPolygon or a Feature wrapping one; WGS84 [lon, lat]). For a Point, the 30 m pixel of each requested USFS image service layer is read (identify); for a polygon, zonal statistics over the rings (computeStatisticsHistograms: pixel count, min, max, mean, median, mode, class fractions). Values are returned both as the service pixel value and scaled to the published quantity with the attribute-table class name. Also returns the county, community and tribal area polygons the geometry intersects with their housing counts and percentile ranks, a location echo, sources and missing[] entries for layers without data. Outside CONUS/Alaska/Hawaii is invalid_input with code outside_coverage.

The response contains the tool result directly.
